<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/usage_alerts/{alert}/states"}
#docs
For the current period: each threshold is `armed`, `triggered` or `resolved`, with the times and the last value. You can rebuild your view from this read alone, without replaying webhooks. A plan alert needs `customer` and answers per subscription.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `alert` | `string` | **yes** | The usage alert's id (ualt_…). |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `customer` | `string` | no | The customer (cus_…). Needed for a plan alert. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `alert` | `string` | ualt_… |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.subject` | `string` | The usage alert subject states's subject. One of `customer`, `subscription`. |
| `data.subscription` | `string` | sub_…, for a plan alert. |
| `data.period_key` | `string` | The period start. |
| `data.resets_at` | `string` | The period end. |
| `data.thresholds` | `array of object` | The usage alert subject states's thresholds. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Threshold states. |
| `400` | A plan alert needs customer. |
| `404` | No such usage alert or customer. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/usage_alerts/ualt_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/states" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
